title: Sunny and the Mushroom Circle | Bedtime Story
description: Sonny the Quokka discovers a perfect circle of tiny moonlit mushrooms growing in the bush — a fairy ring — and sits inside it feeling like the most magical place in the world. A special bedtime story for toddlers from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
narration:
The mushrooms had made a circle.

Sunny stopped on the track and stared. A perfect ring of tiny mushrooms, barely as tall as her paw, growing in the soft earth beneath a stringybark tree. Their caps were pale — almost white in the moonlight — and their gills underneath were a dark silver.

She stepped over one very carefully and walked into the centre of the circle.

Nothing happened, except that the world felt slightly different.

The air inside the circle felt still. Not just quiet — still, the way things are still at the bottom of a deep pool. The moonlight fell into the circle in a perfectly soft column.

Sunny turned slowly in the centre, looking at the mushrooms ringing her in.

She thought: this is a special place.

She did not know how the mushrooms had decided to grow in a circle. She did not know how long they had been here. She only knew that standing inside this ring of small white shapes, under the moonlight, she felt entirely safe and entirely small and entirely wonderful.

She sat down in the middle.

The mushrooms stood quietly around her, their caps tilted slightly — not toward the moon, she noticed, but toward each other.

As if they were listening to each other.

She lay back in the soft earth.

The mushroom ring held her, and the moonlight held the ring.

And she slept the deepest, most enchanted sleep she had ever slept.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, mushroom circle. Goodnight, little one.
